name: Fusion torus cryopump gas-injection test near 5 K
plain_name: Fusion torus cryopump gas-injection test near 5 K
description: Measure response to test-gas injection on a precooled pre-production ITER cryopump, following the actual commissioning sequence.

requirements.rationale: The reported commissioning cold point is approximately 5 K; encoded 5 K is nominal.
A cryopump test stand with controlled gas admission is indispensable.
The pumping measurement needs a vacuum vessel.

missing_information: Gas composition/flow, sorbent capacity, regeneration, pumping speed and tritium suitability are not established by the scalar model.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
